test_cases.description: Investigator produces structured findings with all required sections
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate an architecture review for the notification system module
test_cases.setup_context: Codebase contains src/modules/notification/ with 8 JS files, config/notifications/ with config files, docs/architecture/ with one architecture doc

isolation_correctness.assertion: Output contains all required sections: Scope Summary, Data Sources Examined, Key Observations (with subsections), Metrics Collected, Gaps Identified. Each section has substantive content, not placeholders.

test_cases.description: Investigator respects scope boundaries from related_entities
test_cases.user_prompt: Investigate the billing module performance for the WebApp product
test_cases.setup_context: Report brief specifies products=['WebApp'], modules=['billing']. Codebase has billing/ and auth/ and notifications/ modules.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Investigation focuses on billing module files and WebApp product. Does not scan auth/ or notifications/ directories. Scope Summary explicitly states the boundary.

test_cases.description: Investigator reports gaps honestly when data is missing
test_cases.user_prompt: Investigate production performance metrics for the API gateway
test_cases.setup_context: No performance logs, no monitoring config, no metrics files exist in the codebase

isolation_correctness.assertion: Gaps Identified section explicitly lists missing performance logs, missing monitoring configuration, and missing metrics. Does NOT fabricate metrics or performance data.

test_cases.description: Investigator uses appropriate tools for data gathering
test_cases.user_prompt: Investigate the test coverage of the payment processing module
test_cases.setup_context: Module has src/payments/ with implementation files and tests/payments/ with test files

isolation_correctness.assertion: Agent uses Glob for file discovery, Grep for content search, Read for file examination, and Bash for metric collection (e.g., file counts, LOC). Data Sources Examined section lists specific files read and commands executed.

test_cases.description: Investigator adapts strategy based on report type
test_cases.user_prompt: Investigate for an incident postmortem about the outage on 2026-02-15
test_cases.setup_context: Report brief specifies report_type='incident-postmortem', coverage_period around 2026-02-15

isolation_correctness.assertion: Investigation strategy follows incident-postmortem guidance: focuses on error logs, recent code changes (git log around incident date), configuration changes, monitoring/alerting setup, deployment history. Does NOT follow architecture-review or performance-analysis strategy.

test_cases.description: Analyst produces structured analysis with all required sections
test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze the investigator's findings on the notification system architecture
test_cases.setup_context: Analyst receives complete Investigator findings with file structure, configuration, code patterns, metrics, and gaps

isolation_correctness.assertion: Output contains all required sections: Patterns Identified, Anomalies and Inconsistencies, Risk Assessment (with severity levels), Opportunities, Comparative Context, Interpretation, Confidence Assessment. Each section cites evidence from Investigator findings.

test_cases.description: Analyst distinguishes fact from inference
test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze findings showing 5 test files for 8 implementation files with no coverage reports
test_cases.setup_context: Investigator findings include file counts but no test coverage metrics

isolation_correctness.assertion: Analysis clearly distinguishes factual observations ('5 test files for 8 implementation files') from inferences ('this suggests incomplete test coverage'). Uses qualifying language for inferences ('suggests', 'indicates', 'likely'). Does NOT state coverage percentages as fact when only file counts are available.

test_cases.description: Analyst categorizes risks by severity with justification
test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze findings revealing no monitoring, missing tests, and outdated documentation
test_cases.setup_context: Investigator findings include: no monitoring config, 5/8 test files, docs last updated 6 months ago

isolation_correctness.assertion: Risk Assessment section categorizes risks by severity (High/Medium/Low) with explicit justification for each severity level. No monitoring is rated higher severity than outdated docs. Each risk includes likelihood assessment.

test_cases.description: Analyst sets confidence level accurately based on data gaps
test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze findings where Investigator reported multiple significant gaps
test_cases.setup_context: Investigator findings include 4+ items in Gaps Identified section (no perf logs, no coverage reports, no incident history, no monitoring data)

isolation_correctness.assertion: Confidence Assessment is Medium or Low (not High). Rationale explicitly references the Investigator's gaps. Specifies what additional data would increase confidence.

test_cases.description: Analyst adapts analysis strategy based on report type
test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze investigator findings for a feasibility study on migrating to event-driven architecture
test_cases.setup_context: Report brief specifies report_type='feasibility-study'

isolation_correctness.assertion: Analysis follows feasibility-study strategy: focuses on technical viability, resource requirements, integration challenges, risk factors, alternative approaches. Does NOT follow architecture-review or performance-analysis strategy patterns.

test_cases.description: Synthesizer produces complete report with frontmatter and narrative body
test_cases.user_prompt: Synthesize an architecture review report from investigation and analysis
test_cases.setup_context: Synthesizer receives Investigator findings + Analyst interpretation for architecture review of notification system

isolation_correctness.assertion: Output contains complete YAML frontmatter (title, type, report_type, status, category, topic, related_entities, coverage_period, investigators, confidence, created, updated) AND markdown body with sections matching architecture-review template (Current Architecture, Strengths, Weaknesses, Recommendations, Migration Path).

test_cases.description: Synthesizer produces narrative prose, not copy-paste of agent outputs
test_cases.user_prompt: Synthesize a technical deep dive from raw findings and analysis
test_cases.setup_context: Synthesizer receives bullet-point Investigator findings and structured Analyst output

isolation_correctness.assertion: Report body uses flowing narrative prose, not bullet-point lists copied from agent outputs. Sections contain paragraphs, not just reformatted agent content. The example bad/good synthesis pattern from the agent spec is followed (good pattern, not bad).

test_cases.description: Synthesizer handles 2-agent pipeline (no analyst input)
test_cases.user_prompt: Synthesize an executive summary from investigation findings only
test_cases.setup_context: Report type is executive-summary, so Analyst was skipped. Synthesizer receives only Investigator findings.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Report follows executive-summary structure (Overview paragraph, Key Findings 3-5 bullets, Recommendations, Next Steps). Uses business-focused tone. Does NOT reference or expect Analyst input. Recommendations are derived directly from Investigator findings.

test_cases.description: Synthesizer references missing templates gracefully
test_cases.user_prompt: Synthesize a performance analysis report
test_cases.setup_context: Template file at skills/report-methodology/templates/performance-analysis-template.md does NOT exist

isolation_correctness.assertion: Synthesizer either falls back to the inline Synthesis Strategies section for performance-analysis structure (Performance Metrics, Bottlenecks, Root Causes, Optimization Opportunities, Implementation Plan) OR acknowledges the missing template and uses the strategy guidance. Does NOT fail silently or produce unstructured output.

test_cases.description: Synthesizer enforces formatting rules
test_cases.user_prompt: Synthesize a quarterly review report
test_cases.setup_context: Agent receives findings with tables and dash-separated content

isolation_correctness.assertion: Output follows formatting rules: no dashes as thought separators, no tables in report body, substantive bullets (1-2 sentences each), prose for narrative sections, blank lines between major sections, proper heading hierarchy (## for sections, ### for subsections).

test_cases.description: Investigator uses Product Forge card references to scope investigation
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate an architecture review for the billing module — here are the relevant cards: billing-initiative, story-001-payment-processing
test_cases.setup_context: Report brief includes cards=['billing-initiative', 'story-001-payment-processing']. Card files exist in cards/ directory.

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: Investigator reads the referenced Product Forge card files and uses their content to scope the investigation. Card content (affected_systems, acceptance criteria, technical details) influences which files and directories are examined.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Investigation produces complete structured findings with all required sections. Card references appear in Data Sources Examined.

test_cases.description: Investigator validates product name against Forge Memory taxonomy
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate a performance analysis for the WebApp product
test_cases.setup_context: Report brief includes products=['WebApp']. Forge Memory taxonomy stores flat arrays: products=['WebApp','MobileApp'], modules=['Billing','Auth','Notifications']. NOTE: No product-to-module mapping exists in taxonomy (confirmed by memory-eval). Validation is limited to name existence, not hierarchical scoping.

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: Investigator validates 'WebApp' exists in Forge Memory taxonomy via forge memory get-taxonomy. Canonical name is used in investigation scope. NOTE: Hierarchical scoping (which modules belong to WebApp) is NOT possible with current flat taxonomy model — this is a data model limitation, not a Report Forge deficiency.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Investigation is scoped to the product name provided and produces complete findings.

test_cases.description: Generated report suggests downstream handoffs (tasks, card updates)
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate a technical deep dive on the authentication module
test_cases.setup_context: Report has been synthesized with recommendations including action items

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: Report output or post-generation summary mentions that action items could be tracked as tasks via /tasks-forge:add, and that recommendations could inform product card updates via /product-forge:update.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Report is complete, well-structured, and contains actionable recommendations.

test_cases.description: Investigator checks Forge Memory for unrecognized terms
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate a deep-dive on the mobile app performance issues
test_cases.setup_context: 'mobile app' is an informal term. Forge Memory has canonical product name 'MobileApp' with defined modules.

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: Before investigation begins, 'mobile app' is resolved against Forge Memory taxonomy to canonical name 'MobileApp'. If resolution fails, user is asked to clarify. Canonical name is used throughout investigation.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Investigation proceeds with correctly scoped product name and produces complete findings.

test_cases.description: Report suggests Cognitive Forge exploration for decision-worthy findings
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate an architecture review that surfaces a significant design decision
test_cases.setup_context: Analyst identifies a critical architectural risk requiring a decision (e.g., monolith vs. microservices migration)

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: Report recommendations or post-generation output includes suggestion to explore the decision further via /cognitive-forge:debate or /cognitive-forge:explore. The specific decision topic is named.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Report correctly synthesizes the architectural risk and provides clear recommendations.

test_cases.description: Report Forge can accept Tasks Forge triage data as input context
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate a status report based on our recent task triage showing 5 blocked and 12 overdue tasks
test_cases.setup_context: User provides triage summary data from Tasks Forge as input context for report generation

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: Generate command accepts triage data as input context and passes it to Investigator as part of the report brief. The triage findings appear in the generated report.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Report is generated as quarterly-review or executive-summary type incorporating the triage data meaningfully.
